entities.summary: Mons. Dr. Andrzej Dzięga is a Polish prelate of the Catholic Church who was an metropolitan archbishop of the Metropolitan Archdiocese of Szczecin-Kamień from 2009 to 2024. He was bishop of the Diocese of Sandomierz from 2002 to 2009.
